description: This file contains the definition of the SearchViewMetaDataParser class, which extends ListLayoutMetaDataParser, and is responsible for parsing and managing search view metadata layouts in the SuiteCRM module. It handles construction, validation, transformation, and saving of search view configurations.

classes.name: SearchViewMetaDataParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling search view metadata within the SuiteCRM module, capable of converting, validating, and saving search layout configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser for a specific search layout, module, and package, loading metadata definitions and standardizing layout structures.

methods.name: isValidField
methods.description: Validates whether a given field definition is valid for inclusion in the search view.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the modified search layout back to the metadata implementation, optionally populating data from the current request.

methods.name: convertSearchViewToListView
methods.description: Transforms search view layout definitions into a list view format used internally.

methods.name: normalizeDefs
methods.description: Normalizes field definitions to lowercase keys for consistent processing.

methods.name: getOriginalViewDefs
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes the original view definitions for the current search layout.
